features.title: Define Core Data Models (Utterance, Chunk, Segment, Highlight, Recap)
features.user_visible_behavior: System possesses strictly typed internal data structures for transcript and summary components, enabling consistent API schemas.
verification: Create Pydantic classes for Utterance, Chunk, Segment, Highlight, and HierarchicalRecap.
Create Pydantic classes for API requests/responses (TranscriptIngestionRequest, HighlightUpsertRequest).
Instantiate models with sample data and verify type validation works.
features.notes: Lớp này quy định toàn bộ dữ liệu giao tiếp, cần làm ĐẦU TIÊN để thống nhất format (Data Models).

features.title: Build AI Model Loader & File Repository
features.user_visible_behavior: System successfully loads Hugging Face checkpoints (BERT, deBERTa, BART) into memory and can read/write local transcript files.
verification: Initialize ModelLoader and assert CoherenceNet/NSP BERT weights load successfully.
Initialize ModelLoader and assert deBERTa (Title & Abstractive) weights load successfully.
Initialize ModelLoader and assert BART weights load successfully.
Read a raw JSON/TXT transcript and parse it into Utterance models.
Write a dummy HierarchicalRecap object to a local JSON file.
features.notes: Bộ tải AI Models phải được thiết lập trước khi viết các logic xử lý NLP.

features.title: Implement TextTiling & Chunking Logic
features.user_visible_behavior: System divides a linear transcript into logical topics (Segments) based on topic shifts, and chunks long segments into <= 8 utterances.
verification: Pass sample dialogue to CoherenceScorer (NSP BERT) and verify coherence/depth scores.
Execute TextTiling logic to extract correct segment boundaries.
Verify segments with > 8 utterances are chunked correctly to avoid context overflow.
features.notes: Sử dụng AI model thứ nhất: NSP BERT.

features.title: Implement Summarization Orchestrator
features.user_visible_behavior: System coordinates AI models to generate chapter titles, abstractive chunk summaries (3rd person), and key highlights.
verification: Generate a chapter title using deBERTa (hierarchical_title) on a full segment.
Generate 3rd-person summary using deBERTa (hierarchical_abstractive) on a chunk.
Extract key points and action items using BART (highlights pipeline).
Assemble the final HierarchicalRecap object.
features.notes: Sử dụng các AI models: deBERTa và BART.

features.title: Create FastAPI Endpoints
features.user_visible_behavior: Clients can trigger meeting processing and interact with recaps (update titles, edit highlights) via RESTful API routes.
verification: Start FastAPI development server.
Submit POST /api/v1/meetings/process and receive 200 OK.
Submit PUT /api/v1/meetings/{id}/segments/{id} to update chapter title.
Retrieve full recap via GET /api/v1/meetings/{id}/recap.
features.notes: Kết nối các Service bằng API chuẩn REST.

features.title: Develop Client Interface
features.user_visible_behavior: Users have an interactive interface to view hierarchical meeting minutes, edit titles, and check off action items.
verification: Load client application.
Verify meeting chapters and 8-utterance chunks render correctly.
Edit a chapter title in the UI and verify it updates.
Mark an action item as checked.
features.notes: Phần trình diễn sản phẩm cuối cùng.
